items.title: Eddie Summers Interview, 1960-09-16
items.q: It was Claiborne Williams and LeBlanc, Morris LeBlanc.

ctx.x: You mentioned some of them like the Mary Williams and the trumpet. Any others? Well, see the Mary Williams, they didn't play in that band.

That was the later group. That was the later group. It was Claiborne Williams and LeBlanc, Morris LeBlanc. He used to play. Them was older men. Yeah. Those men around. If they was living, they'd be about 90 years old. Yes. What did he play, LeBlanc? LeBlanc, he played saxophone. Do you remember any other names in the group? Morris LeBlanc. Morris LeBlanc. Yeah. And my daddy named L.M. Summers, or Leon Summers. Claiborne Williams. I see where else they're. I just remember some of those fellas named me. They've…
Did they use drums in the band? He used drums in his band. I remember the drummer. I guess.
